title: Guard CI scripts/ci/check_no_go.sh (mode diff/full)
description:
Gunakan skill squad-lead dan squad-backend.

Spec: SPEC-011 · Backlog: BL-086.

1. Buat scripts/ci/check_no_go.sh (bash, set -euo pipefail): mode diff -> gagal bila git diff --name-only --diff-filter=A origin/testing...HEAD memuat *.go, go.mod, go.sum, go.work; mode full -> gagal bila git ls-files '*.go' 'go.mod' 'go.sum' 'go.work' tidak kosong.
2. Tambahkan step 'check_no_go.sh diff' di job repo-structure .github/workflows/ci.yml (selaras dengan komentar ci.yml:3-5).
3. Tambahkan test kecil scripts/ci/check_no_go.test.sh mengikuti pola run_clippy.test.sh (repo git sementara).
4. Catat di RPT bahwa Owner harus menambahkan pemanggilan ke ~/Apps/dev-ci gates.sh (di luar repo).

BRANCH: testing -> feat/ci-check-no-go-guard.
Target PR ke branch testing. Alokasi pengerjaan: <= 1 jam.
PRASYARAT (DEPENDENCY): TASK-055 (PR merged ke testing).
acceptance: Mode diff gagal saat file .go baru ditambahkan, lolos saat file .go lama diubah
Mode full gagal di testing saat ini (Go masih ada) — diharapkan
PR dibuka ke branch testing, CI dev-ci (gates.sh) hijau, RPT memuat output perintah verifikasi apa adanya
